an5.57:1.1: bhikkhave ṭhānāni abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbāni itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:1.3: Jarādhammo 'mhi jaraṃ anatīto ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:1.4: Vyādhidhammo 'mhi vyādhiṃ anatīto ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:1.5: Maraṇadhammo 'mhi maraṇaṃ anatīto ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:1.6: Sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:1.8: yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā,
an5.57:1.9: tassa dāyādo bhavissāmī ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca jarādhammo 'mhi jaraṃ anatīto ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā? 3.
an5.57:2.2: Atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ yobbane yobbanamado, yena madena mattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
an5.57:2.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato, yo yobbane yobbanamado, so sabbaso vā pahīyati, tanu vā pana hoti.
an5.57:2.4: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca jarādhammo 'mhi jaraṃ anatīto ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca vyādhidhammo 'mhi vyādhiṃ anatīto ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā? 4.
an5.57:3.2: Atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ ārogye ārogyamado, yena madena mattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
an5.57:3.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato, yo ārogye ārogyamado, so sabbaso vā pahīyati, tanu vā pana hoti.
an5.57:3.4: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca vyādhidhammo 'mhi vyādhiṃ anatīto ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca maraṇadhammo 'mhi maraṇaṃ anatīto ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā? 5.
an5.57:4.2: Atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ jīvite jīvitamado, yena madena mattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
an5.57:4.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato, yo jīvite jīvitamado, so sabbaso vā pahīyati, tanu vā pana hoti.
an5.57:4.4: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca maraṇadhammo 'mhi maraṇaṃ anatīto ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā? 6.
an5.57:5.2: Atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ piyesu chandarāgo, yena rāgena rattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
an5.57:5.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato, yo piyesu chandarāgo, so sabbaso vā pahīyati, tanu vā pana hoti.
an5.57:5.4: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
an5.57:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca kammassako 'mhi kammadāyādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi
an5.57:6.2: kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, tassa dāyādo bhavissāmī ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā? 7.
an5.57:6.3: Atthi bhikkhave sattānaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ.
an5.57:6.4: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato sabbaso vā duccaritaṃ pahīyati, tanu vā pana hoti.
an5.57:6.5: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthavasaṃ paṭicca kammassako 'mhi kammadāyādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi
an5.57:6.7: tassa dāyādo bhavissāmī ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā. 8.
an5.57:7.1: Sace so bhikkhave ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.57:7.2: ‘na kho ahañ c' ev' eko jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattanaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbe sattā jarādhammā jaraṃ anatītā' ti,
an5.57:7.3: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
an5.57:7.4: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an5.57:7.5: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā vyantihonti.
an5.57:8.1: ‘Na kho ahañ c' ev' eko vyādhidhammo vyādhiṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbe sattā vyādhidhammā vyādhiṃ anatītā' ti
an5.57:8.2: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
an5.57:8.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an5.57:8.4: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā vyantihonti.
an5.57:9.1: ‘Na kho ahañ c' ev' eko maraṇadhammo maraṇaṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbe sattā maraṇadhammā maraṇaṃ anatīta' ti,
an5.57:9.2: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
an5.57:9.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an5.57:9.4: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā vyantihonti.
an5.57:10.1: ‘Na kho mayh' ev' ekassa sabbehi piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo' ti,
an5.57:10.2: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
an5.57:10.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an5.57:10.4: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā vyantihonti.
an5.57:11.1: ‘Na kho ahañ c' ev' eko kammassako 'mhi kammadāyādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, tassa dāyādo bhavissāmi,
an5.57:11.2: atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbe sattā kammassakā kammadāyādā kammayonī kammabandhū kammapaṭisaraṇā, yaṃ kammaṃ karissanti kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā, tassa dāyādā bhavissantī' ti,
an5.57:11.3: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
an5.57:11.4: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an5.57:11.5: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā vyantihontī ti.
